items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t know. I think the critics run hot and cold. ... I don’t have any strong negativisms in general about jazz critics or critics in general.

ctx.x: It may have been The King.

But I can remember reading the reviews. There were all kinds of arguments on the part of Leonard Feather and others. They said, " Nobody can play that fast on the trombone. It must be a valve trombone."
